page.overview:
Who is Andrea Ganan?

Andrea Ganan was a Mentat in the service of House Atreides.

Andrea Ganan was approached by the Prisoner in Arrakeen. She asked them why Anton Tolliver had not delivered the reports through the usual channels, to which they replied that she would not be seeing Tolliver again. She told them that House Atreides was in a dilemma, for it could not win the War of Assassins while cleaving to its ideals and honor, but to win at the cost of these factors would also be a death to the House. Her solution was to insulate, having certain members carry out the distasteful deeds of spycraft and intrigue without damaging the House's reputation. She informed the Prisoner that Simone Von Konig, her counterpart in House Harkonnen, was also investigating the mysterious deaths sweeping Arrakeen. She tasked them with investigating the involvement of Captain Tighe Skorda and the Sandflies in the outbreak, which she suspected to be manufactured.
